| t | (30000,) | float64 |
| trace | (30000,) | int64 |

The large `das` array is the main DAS strain-rate measurement (30,000 time samples x 384 channels); `t` and `trace` index the time samples, `channel`, `x`, `y`, `z` describe the 384 sensor channels (id and spatial coordinates), and `crs` is a scalar coordinate-reference-system flag.
